notes.title: Devlog #20241123
notes.content:
[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Character Models : [/b]Introduced first-person body visibility. Players can see their legs and feet when looking down or slide.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/c43317cdb1f8a7647bf3132ecb69003b3519bba2.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Vehicles : [/b]Added three drivable vehicles. Players can switch seats, view speed and fuel stats on HUD, refuel vehicles, and extract fuel into containers. Interactive elements like storage boxes, workbenches, and crafting benches are installed within vehicles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/9866f5052a6e348587fea08e80b71ac055dd2e78.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Character Selection : [/b]Implemented a character creation interface that allows players to choose from various characters at the start. Additional characters can be unlocked by meeting specific criteria, each with unique abilities and starting items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/3420a89f6effb1dcbbbeba132b15ae81e067f199.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Game Flow : [/b]Players select exploration areas from the camp, each with different entry costs. Each area consists of multiple levels, allowing players to either retreat to camp or proceed to the next level after completion.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/330bc7c724af992968e94a4f69a17f70c1746874.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/e7d891bca2b761010275b8ef811b697fae29352f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/0b3193b97bd8c49e225bbf20aa3c1749f149bb79.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Procedural World Generation : [/b]Maps for wilderness and urban settings are generated based on specific rules, including ecological environments, resource distribution, and monster placements, ensuring a unique experience for each adventure.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/844d97b7a31c07cae3315f2a8dee66426e524c8c.gif[/img]
[/list]

notes.title: DevLog #20240929
notes.content:
[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Multi-Sight Customization : [/b]Equip multiple sights on weapons for quick switching while aiming.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/004514690ad13e2de444eaf157172e9c40ec9947.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Multi-Language Localization : [/b]Change the game’s language anytime in settings with immediate effect.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/4567e8cffbc3ededb6a45fd53dbfd38bd3e4f424.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Item Quality Attributes : [/b]All items will have quality attributes affecting durability, damage, and other stats, categorized into five levels: white, green, blue, purple, and orange.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/05e3e06c3132a7dfe74ca25bfe03f25daafe517f.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Inventory Management : [/b]Items occupy varying sizes based on their dimensions. Transfer items between inventory and storage by dragging or right-clicking.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/c50ea7ce11e5d1b35fc1a6b6742740cb960f69cf.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Crusher : [/b]Place items in the crusher to break them down over time into materials. Larger, higher-quality items will take longer to decompose, and items can be retrieved at any time to avoid accidental loss.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/265337b9ec044cb3fdf43e8ebfdc4beae21ba950.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Junk Items for Decomposition : [/b]Many salvageable items in the wasteland will be designated as junk for decomposition into materials at the camp.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/a19fd8ed49a4a186d5707e297dd4ab797bef9017.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Crafting Bench : [/b]Craft various items, including weapons, armor, and consumables, using materials. Each item has a crafting level; higher levels yield better quality. Orange-quality items can only be produced at the crafting bench.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/9dddafc2c2151252ea4983d3b45366c55d266e77.gif[/img]
[/list]

notes.title: DevLog #20240825
notes.content:

notes.title: Dev Log #20240727
notes.content:
[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Drag-and-Drop Inventory Management[/b]: Players can now equip and unequip items in their backpack by simply dragging them with the mouse.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/f86fd586906d7e4a0fd3dc3d0904ed6873916c95.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Physiological System[/b]: Characters will experience hunger and thirst over time. Excessive hunger or thirst will result in a gradual decrease in HP. Added food and water items to the game, allowing players to manage and replenish their hunger and thirst levels.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/b5d8cd77ced104d1a0424b565279b3018317eb2c.gif[/img]

[*] [b]First Aid Injection[/b]: Added first aid injection item that can be used to restore HP, providing an additional option for health management.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/4809e17a7634764f6cffce4fe5ec5dc4875ce3db.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Melee Combat Animations[/b]: Enhanced melee combat with distinct animations for stabbing and swinging attacks, adding more depth and variety to close-quarters combat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/0dc205ccac0ffd08a4fa0582490aa4128ae063d0.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Elite Zombie Enemy[/b]: Added an elite zombie equipped with dual weapons and multiple attack modes, featuring two combat forms:
    [b]a. Car Door Shield Form[/b]: Primarily uses a car door as a shield to block frontal damage. At close range, it uses the shield to bash players, dealing melee damage. At long range, it smashes the shield into the ground to create a shockwave, which players can avoid by jumping.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/144a44889af7e28829941c1b5a740c67a1d93fba.gif[/img]

    [b]b. Stone Hammer Form[/b]: At close range, it swings a stone hammer to perform multi-hit combos with high damage. At long range, it throws three stone hammers that adjust their trajectory towards the player. Players can evade these by moving laterally or using obstacles for cover.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/6b3b466d3650e549d217ad36eba3dc092a2e41d1.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Wild Map[/b]: Added a new wild area located outside the East Gate of the city quarantine zone, expanding the exploration range.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/696b13d3830bb56bfe9f45dbfaf97d3f385a876f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/153315bb2a376ac00a959509ec813a70e8a36145.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/bba5299ed4e10a03b4914aba3f59a6a4bf3a7a12.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/5963dd47d8c44cc383fcf0b14fa4223051cbf6f3.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/a9ceb07e4d717a7638ccea799013acd3d05bedf3.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/6a5f8b57a560aa8a678d6127d5d2b1d519268a7b.gif[/img]
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Log #20240720
notes.content:
[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Swimming and Diving[/b]: Introduced swimming and diving functions. When diving, you need to consume oxygen. If the oxygen level reaches zero, HP will be deducted over time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/af95220ea0fbb2e7564fc3368c4b7ee5864ec1fa.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Shark Enemies[/b]: Added shark enemies that roam the waters near the hideout island. They will patrol around the island and attack approaching players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/03774dadf4c50a71c6b154b7c930b371df2a4134.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Interactive Chest Highlights[/b]: All interactive chests will be highlighted and an interaction animation will play when the player is nearby, ensuring no search opportunities are missed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/39c5af768d460c9dd2e1d9cc0bc23ef86afbb7a4.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Helicopter Multi-Route Flights[/b]: The hideout's helicopter now supports multiple flight routes. After reaching the destination and the player disembarks, the helicopter will return to the hideout. When the player calls for evacuation using the walkie-talkie, the helicopter will come to their vicinity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/5e905c9ae3afaaeef80835f2109359003bffdc44.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Armor Equipment[/b]: Introduced armor equipment. When players wearing armor take damage, a portion of the damage to their health will be mitigated and the durability of the armor will be reduced. Once the armor's durability reaches zero, it will break and no longer provide damage reduction.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/516a3eeed87819a9bbbce0bb74deb47d9a47fc81.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Special Hit Effects[/b]: Some weapon attachments provide special effects on impact, such as ignition, poisoning, stun, slowdown, freezing, penetration, and rebound.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/04d75a4486770403d3d6dbdcb5945882916fd0ef.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Lockpicking[/b]: Added doors that can be opened with lock picks. When you find a key, you won't immediately know which lock it opens, but lockpicking tools can handle almost any lock. This requires skill and patience, as well as sufficient lock picks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/b34309f8e76123dee25e2e05b2c02c946f6c8935.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Weapon Attachment Customization[/b]: Replacing weapon attachments can alter the weapon's basic attributes, such as rate of fire, accuracy, reload speed, recoil, damage, and aiming speed.
[*] [b]Weapon Durability[/b]: Both firearms and melee weapons now have durability. When durability reaches zero, the weapon will break and become unusable. Weapon durability can be repaired at the repair table in the hideout.

[*] [b]Enemy Hearing System[/b]: Added the enemies' hearing system and configured all weapons with volume levels. Shooting with an unsilenced gun will attract most enemies within 50 meters. The helicopter's engine also generates significant noise when active, attracting enemies from a wider area.
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Log #20240713
notes.content:
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Gunsmith System: Modify firearm attributes by changing attachments at the workbench and apply stickers for special abilities and skills.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/180e482a2b69ca933625e6d25fffc0e3be11e6a0.gif[/img]

[*] Day-Night Cycle System: The environment will switch between day and night as time passes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/497bac100718c4752968432a323e1e6d72b9380c.gif[/img]

[*] AI Vertical Movement: AI enemies can move vertically within a certain height range by jumping, allowing them to reach places like rooftops or low buildings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/0336634d3c9a6deabdc5add1ca944b5cbd1807a6.gif[/img]

[*] Evacuation System: Use a walkie-talkie to request evacuation. Board the helicopter within the specified time to ensure successful evacuation and return to the hideout; otherwise, wait a period before requesting evacuation again.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076661/872b0ae28d42b8a80b47104189fbc5f56efbf6b7.gif[/img]
[/list]
